title: The Song of Deborah and Barak

questions.question: Who sang on that day?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:1 (ESV): "Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day..."

questions.question: What happened to the mountains before the Lord?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:5 (ESV): "The mountains quaked before the LORD..."

questions.question: How is Jael described in the song?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:24 (ESV): "Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite..."

questions.question: Who waited for Sisera's return?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:28 (ESV): "Out of the window she peered, the mother of Sisera wailed..."

questions.question: How many years did the land have rest after the victory?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:31 (ESV): "...And the land had rest for forty years."

questions.question: What tribe stayed among the sheepfolds?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:16 (ESV): "Why did you sit still among the sheepfolds, to hear the piping for the flocks? Among the clans of Reuben..."

questions.question: Who fought from heaven?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:20 (ESV): "From heaven the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera."

questions.question: Which river swept them away?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:21 (ESV): "The torrent Kishon swept them away, the ancient torrent, the torrent Kishon."

questions.question: What city was cursed for not coming to the help of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:23 (ESV): "Curse Meroz, says the angel of the LORD, curse its inhabitants thoroughly, because they did not come to the help of the LORD..."

questions.question: In the days of Shamgar and Jael, what was the condition of the roads?
options: They were abandoned, and travelers kept to the byways
questions.correctAnswer: They were abandoned, and travelers kept to the byways
questions.explanation: Judges 5:6 (ESV): "In the days of Shamgar... the highways were abandoned, and travelers kept to the byways."

questions.question: Finish the verse: "So may all your enemies ____, O Lord!"
questions.explanation: Judges 5:31 (ESV): "So may all your enemies perish, O LORD!"

questions.question: What did Sisera ask for, and what did Jael give him (according to the song)?
options: He asked for water and she gave him milk
He asked for wine and she gave him water
questions.correctAnswer: He asked for water and she gave him milk
questions.explanation: Judges 5:25 (ESV): "He asked for water and she gave him milk; she brought him curds in a noble's bowl."

questions.question: Who is the "Mother in Israel"?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:7 (ESV): "The villagers ceased in Israel... until I, Deborah, arose as a mother in Israel."

questions.question: Which tribe is mentioned as having its "root" in Amalek?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:14 (ESV): "From Ephraim their root they marched down into the valley..." (Some translations mention Amalek here).

questions.question: Why did Dan stay with the ____?
questions.explanation: Judges 5:17 (ESV): "...and Dan, why did he stay with the ships?"

key_verse_text: So may all your enemies perish, O LORD! But your friends be like the sun as he rises in his might. (ESV)
